title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Duo #23 (가로 띠·물결 / 세로 띠·물결 | 뱀비늘+흑요암금+코이비늘+석재 / 이레즈미+목재+공작눈무늬+뱀비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Turkish, in her mid 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, sleek silver-grey hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real pores, real living eyes, 150 drop dangles piercings set with rubies in brass-toned metal, wearing a single piece of mixed-metal a hair ornament. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 26% of the way down her figure from the top, about 45% of the way down her figure from the top and about 65% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
